title: A witness channel: subtracting ordinary pickup without inventing a cause
question: Can a calibrated environmental witness separate a stipulated receiver-port signal from ordinary pickup, and which transfer/crosstalk assumptions remain necessary?

incoming_evidence.accepted: Full calibrated coherent readout localizes effective drives, while restricted readouts and uncalibrated phase admit exact or instrumental rivals.
incoming_evidence.selected_objection: R2B requests an environmental witness with explicit uncertainty, unknown-transfer rivals, singular crosstalk and remaining physical-source identity ambiguity.

historical_lenses.Newton: Add an observation that changes the inverse map, then identify remaining hidden-cause fibers.
historical_lenses.Tesla: Include the complete pickup/readout pathway and challenge omitted coupling into the witness.

classification: Synthetic effective-voltage observation model, not an axion experiment, physical environmental measurement or new force mechanism.

state_and_units.s: stipulated signal contribution at receiver port, complex V peak
state_and_units.b: environmental witness-equivalent nuisance, complex V peak
state_and_units.y: reconstructed receiver effective voltage, complex V peak
state_and_units.w: calibrated witness-equivalent voltage, complex V peak; not automatically raw coil voltage
state_and_units.beta: complex dimensionless signal leakage into witness
state_and_units.epsilon_y,epsilon_w: supplied deterministic complex measurement-error radii, V
state_and_units.Delta_a: supplied complex transfer uncertainty radius, dimensionless

model.clean_witness: y=s+a b; w=b. Known a gives linear map [[1,a],[0,1]] over C² (four real dimensions) and s=y-a w.
model.without_witness: y only has real rank2, domain4, nullity2 with complex kernel(-a t,t), t in V.
model.deterministic_disk: |shat-s| ≤ epsilon_y+|ahat|epsilon_w+Delta_a(|what|+epsilon_w). Prove triangle inequality and test boundary fixtures; distinguish bound from confidence interval.
model.calibration_scope: The 2mV receiver error bound is a NEW stipulated effective-voltage bound, chosen slightly above the R2 nominal1.932mV scale. It is not derived for all R3 circuit conditions and must be separately calibrated physically. No real sensor performance is asserted.
model.unknown_transfer_rival: If a is unbounded, a'=a+δa and s'=s-δa b reproduce both y and w. For the nonzero fixture choose δa=s/b so s'=0. Domain(s,b,a) is C³=R⁶, local real rank4/nullity2; explicit tangent kernel(-b t,0,t), t dimensionless.
model.witness_crossleak: If w=b+beta s with known beta, matrix [[1,a],[beta,1]] has complex determinant1-a beta. Along beta=t/a report inversion/conditioning for t≠1. At t=1 provide exact kernel(-a u,u), u in V, and withhold unique inversion. Unknown beta is not assumed harmless.
model.physical_identity: Even with a clean known witness, s=s_exotic+d with unmonitored ordinary same-port drive d gives domain(s_exotic,d,b)=C³=R⁶, rank4/nullity2 and exact kernel(t,-t,0), t in V. Save finite pair with all5mV assigned to s_exotic versus all to d and identical y,w.
model.boundary: Effective single-frequency linear transfer model only. No stochastic noise/search statistics, geometric axion coupling, electromagnetic field solve, thermal mechanics, gravity law or actual environmental observations.

controls: Clean exact witness recovers injected complex5mV signal
Zero stipulated signal with background alone subtracts to zero for known exact transfer
512 boundary cases: eight phases each for receiver error, witness error and transfer error; report inclusion, not probability
Construct one aligned error fixture attaining the data-dependent bound within tolerance
Unknown a admits exact zero-signal rival matching BOTH readouts
Real ranks/domain/nullities and explicit kernels for no witness, clean known witness, unknowna local map, singular crossleak and expanded source-identity map
Near-singular crossleak path: determinant, rank and condition; singularpoint returns no unique inverse
Remaining physical-source identity exact rival survives perfect witness subtraction

acceptance.positive_control: Nominal5mV signal disk excludes zero under statedcleanwitness/calibration assumptions; otherwise reportfailurewithoutretuning.

falsifier: Failure of the predicted calibrated subtraction or bound rejects this implementation. An exact ordinary rival blocks an exotic-source interpretation even if a nonzero effective signal remains.
limits: Witness calibration and stationarity must be measured; sensor blindness to the signal is an assumption to test
Known crosstalk can be inverted only away from its singular boundary
No real apparatus, dark-matter sensitivity, free-energy extraction or gravity modification is established
Three authorized rounds end here; future physical tests are roadmap items, not hidden extra loops
